d: Cyclone Murasu Alert: : bangal ki khari men uth raha hai ek aisa tuphan...jo apne sath 120 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se chalne vali khatarnak havaen aur musladhar barish la sakta hai.... aakhir is tuphan ka asar kin-kin rajyon par parne vala hai... kya aandhr pradesh aur odisha men ek bar phir tabahi ka manjar dekhne ko milega... aur sabse bara saval.... kya bihar tak bhi pahunchega chakravat murasu ka asar... agar aap bhi mausam men hone vale is bare badlav ko lekar pareshan hain...to is riport ko aakhir tak jarur dekhie.... kyonki aane vale kuchh ghante kaee ilakon ke lie behad…
